en: Sepia-toned postcard showing an ornate baroque-style garden scene. A richly sculpted stone grotto or fountain, overgrown with ivy, forms the central focus. It features reliefs of mythological figures, with additional statues placed on stairways and pedestals above and around it. In the foreground on the lawn sits a statue group of a partially draped figure with a child and a vessel. The setting is within a lush, formal park. Printed caption text in German appears along the bottom edge.
